tei:respStmt.tei:name: Efraim Feinstein

tei:editionStmt.tei:edition: Read directly from the scanned 1949 printing, page by page

tei:div.tei:p: May he who blessed our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, bless this entire congregation and all other congregations—their wives, their sons and daughters, and all that belongs to them. May he bless those who dedicate synagogues for worship and those who enter therein to pray, those who provide lamps for lighting and wine for Kiddush and Havdalah and those who give food to the transient guests and charity to the poor, as well as all those who faithfully occupy themselves with the needs of the community. May the Holy One, blessed be he, grant them their reward, remove from them all sickness, preserve them in good health, and forgive all their sins; may he bless and prosper their work and the work of all Israel their brethren; and let us say, Amen.
